title: vibes
tagline: App for sharing short form video content and livestream. Everything is censorship resistant and built on decentralised architecture
description: This web app is built for short-form video content and live streams. Everyone has the right to share any content they want if they have a wallet address and internet. The idea behind this project is to allow creators to express their short-form content without any risk of getting laid down
how_its_made: This project uses @livepeer for Livestream distribution. We used web3.storage for reel storage and storing users' profile data. We also utilized tableland to keep all reels and profile CIDs to retrieve them easily. Lastly, we integrated world coin for user verification before signing up.
